data.name: RibEdgeRefresh.SuperTip
data.value: Refreshes the active sheet. If control sheet is present and any parameters are modified then the modified parameters are taken into consideration. If no control sheet is present then the sheet is refreshed by the last runID.

data.name: RibEdgeRefreshAll.SuperTip
data.value: Refreshes all the sheets in workbook (only reports not scheduled processess). If control sheet is present and any parameters are modified then the modified parameters are taken into consideration. If no control sheet is present then the each sheet is refreshed by the last runID.

data.name: RibControlSheet.SuperTip
data.value: This will create a parameter control sheet where all the parameters in the current workbook will be arranged by report name, If already exists then the existing sheet is completely replaced by the new parameters from the current workbook.
